stages.title: Start and organize
say: turn this idea into a plan
set this project up properly
add this without breaking my scripts

skills.research-kickoff: Turns an idea into a verified research plan within days.
skills.project-structure: Keeps order in a project: code, data, results, governing documents.
skills.research-code: Changes research software so that your scripts keep working.

stages.title: Design and run experiments
say: is this design worth the GPU hours?
write the job script for the cluster
this table has a billion rows

skills.ml-experiment-design: Plans experiments before compute is spent: plan, configs, gates.
skills.research-design-review: Decides a model design before compute is spent, and locks it.
skills.cluster-jobs: Runs work on a batch cluster (LSF, SLURM) from a laptop.
skills.large-data: Handles data too big for memory, resumable and honest about coverage.
skills.performance-tuning: Makes training or a pipeline faster without changing the science.

stages.title: Read the results
say: why did this run collapse?
is this ablation fair?
what does this embedding hold?

skills.training-diagnostics: Diagnoses a training run: collapsed or alive, bug or effect.
skills.ml-evaluation: Makes a benchmark, ablation or leaderboard measure what it claims.
skills.representation-probes: Judges a learned representation against its noise floors.
skills.embedding-maps: Renders and judges maps of learned embeddings.
skills.distribution-comparison: Compares two datasets, with a no-difference baseline for each number.
skills.tabular-fm-studies: Reference and tested scripts for tabular foundation models.
skills.stats-reporting: Decides how statistics are computed, drawn and worded.

stages.title: Make the figures
say: make figure 2 from results/
draw the architecture as a TikZ figure
this plot looks machine-made

skills.figure-development: Takes a results figure from its claim to checked final panels.
skills.data-figures: Builds data panels in one house style, composed at exact millimeters.
skills.tikz-figures: Draws architecture diagrams and schematics in TikZ and PGFPlots.
skills.canvas-schematics: Builds method and concept schematics on an HTML canvas.
skills.design-system: One visual system across figure, slide, poster and web page.

stages.title: Write
say: draft the methods section
this paragraph sounds like AI
assemble a book from my papers

skills.paper-writing: Writes a paper from table of contents to final prose, claim by claim.
skills.ml-paper-writing: Writes and checks papers for NeurIPS, ICML and ICLR.
skills.nature-methods-writing: Writes Online Methods and Supplementary Notes for Nature journals.
skills.author-voice: Keeps text that goes out under your name in your own voice.
skills.humanizer: Takes the machine out of a text without changing what it says.
skills.latex-typesetting: Typesets in LaTeX and builds a PDF that passes a scripted gate.
skills.book: Assembles and builds a book-length document from your own papers.
skills.research-report: Builds the report for a supervisor as one HTML file plus a PDF.

stages.title: Check before it goes out
say: check everything before I send it
does the paper still say what the code does?
try to break this

skills.qc: The gate before anything is handed over, with a short report.
skills.integrity-audit: Checks that the text matches the code, the records and the data.
skills.adversarial-audit: Runs a multi-agent adversarial audit before compute or submission.
skills.paper-code-parity: Keeps a paper and its code in agreement while both change.

stages.title: Answer reviewers, present, release
say: answer reviewer 2
turn the paper into a poster and a talk
release the code and the weights

skills.rebuttal: Writes replies to peer review: rebuttals, revisions, chair notes.
skills.poster: Builds a conference poster from the paper as one A0 page.
skills.talk-slides: Builds a talk from one file: slides, PDF twin, speaker script.
skills.paper-website: Builds, checks and deploys the project website of a paper.
skills.research-release: Releases the code, weights, notebooks and data of a paper.

stages.title: Work with agents
say: write the brief for the other session
run this overnight
turn my history into skills

skills.prompt-writing: Writes the brief another agent works from, with no other context.
skills.agent-orchestration: Runs work with AI agents that survives crashes and comes back true.
skills.distill-skills: Turns your own history with an AI agent into installable skills.
